name: std-survival-board-3d
description: 3D single-hero survival board FRAME: composes hero-nav (units + move budget as energy) + gather (wood/stone resource nodes) + fx-particles + survival-flow (build-camp win / energy-out loss) onto one shared GameState with a single render authority. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/tiles/features/camp thresholds via config.

schema.description: 3D single-hero survival board FRAME: composes hero-nav (units + move budget as energy) + gather (wood/stone resource nodes) + fx-particles + survival-flow (build-camp win / energy-out loss) onto one shared GameState with a single render authority. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/tiles/features/camp thresholds via config.
schema.name: std-survival-board-3d

gridHeight.description: Grid row count clamping move + wander bounds
gridHeight.label: Grid Height

gridWidth.description: Grid column count clamping move + wander bounds
gridWidth.label: Grid Width

moveBudget.description: Moves the hero may spend before the round is lost if objectives remain
moveBudget.label: Move Budget

running.description: When true, MOVE/WANDER intents are applied; toggle to freeze the board
running.label: Running

tiles.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks (auto-generated all-passable when empty)
tiles.label: Tiles

units.description: Seed roster: the player hero plus any neutral NPCs
units.label: Initial Units

emits.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

events.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose
events.name: Hero Stepped

features.description: Board features — resource nodes (matched by woodType/stoneType) plus decorations
features.label: Features

running.description: When true, hero steps onto resource nodes are gathered; toggle to freeze
running.label: Running

stoneType.description: Feature type counted as a stone resource node
stoneType.label: Stone Type

woodType.description: Feature type counted as a wood resource node
woodType.label: Wood Type

yieldPerNode.description: Wood or stone gained per node gathered
yieldPerNode.label: Yield Per Node

emits.description: Pickup particle produced when a resource node is gathered; a fx-particles listener spawns it
Wood/stone totals and moves remaining after this step; a survival-flow listener decides loss

events.description: Pickup particle produced when a resource node is gathered; a fx-particles listener spawns it
events.name: Burst

events.description: Wood/stone totals and moves remaining after this step; a survival-flow listener decides loss
events.name: Resources

decayRate.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.
decayRate.label: Decay Rate

fx.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.
fx.label: Initial Fx

running.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.
running.label: Running

running.description: When true, RESOURCES/BUILD_CAMP signals resolve win/lose; toggle to freeze
running.label: Running

emits.description: Emitted once the match resolves to won or lost

events.description: Emitted once the match resolves to won or lost
events.name: Game End

assetManifest.description: Per-role model manifest resolving tile/unit/feature models by terrain/category key.
assetManifest.label: Asset Manifest

campStone.description: Stone required before the Build Camp action is allowed.
campStone.label: Camp Stone

campWood.description: Wood required before the Build Camp action is allowed.
campWood.label: Camp Wood

extraStats.description: Board-specific HUD stats appended after the standard set.
extraStats.label: Extra Stats

fxPresets.description: This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark.
fxPresets.label: Fx Presets

movementRange.description: Max manhattan distance the hero may step per move.
movementRange.label: Movement Range
